brief:
Former US officials who resigned over Gaza policy are calling on Democratic presidential candidates in the 2028 race to denounce the Biden administration's approach, Al Jazeera English reported. The officials, who left their posts in protest, are seeking explicit repudiation of current Gaza policy as a condition for their support.

The push reflects deepening divisions within Democratic ranks over the administration's stance toward Israel's military operations in Gaza. Whether leading candidates adopt such denouncements could signal a significant shift in Democratic Party positioning ahead of the next election cycle.
dek: Biden-era officials who quit over Gaza urge Democratic candidates for next presidential race to denounce the policy.
title: Former US officials urge 2028 candidates to reject Biden's Gaza policy
